system.description:
Your luck is such that catastrophe occurs less frequently for you when you are engaged in stressful situations.

Effect: Once per Skill Challenge that has a chance of Catastrophic Failure, this Failure occurs only if you fail a Skill Check by 15 or more. In addition, when a Catastrophic Failure occurs, you accrue one Failure in the Skill Challenge, not two.

Special: This Feat is allowed only in campaigns that use Skill Challenges.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
